name: Athena
source: A doctor with "mixed alien heritage" aboard the warship [i]Ithaca[/i] alongside two other passengers. She is the only survivor of an incident at the refugee camp ITOH. With three days until the ship reaches its destination, Athena is forced to fill her time exploring the ship and conversing with its two other inhabitants.
